sections.title: Use of Proceeds
sections.excerpt:
USE OF PROCEEDS We may issue and sell shares of our common stock
having aggregate gross sales proceeds of up to $100,000,000 from time to time (before deducting sales agent commissions and expenses).
Because there is no minimum offering amount required in this offering, the actual total public offering amount, commissions and proceeds
to us, if any, are not determinable at this time. There can be no assurance that we will sell any shares under, or fully utilize, the
sales agreement with Allen & Company LLC as a source of financing. We currently intend to use the net proceeds from
this offering, together with our existing cash, cash equivalents and investments, for research and development and working capital and
general corporate purposes. Our expected use of the net proceeds from this

sections.title: Dilution
sections.excerpt:
DILUTION If you invest in our common stock, your interest
will be diluted immediately to the extent of the difference between the public offering price per share of our common stock and the as
adjusted net tangible deficit per share of our common stock after this offering. The net tangible deficit of our common stock as
of September 30, 2026 was approximately $(395.8) million, or approximately ($1.27) per share. Net tangible deficit per share represents
the amount of our total tangible assets, less our total liabilities, divided by the total number of shares of our common stock outstanding
as of September 30, 2026. After giving effect to the sale of our common stock in the aggregate amount

sections.title: Dividend Policy
sections.excerpt:
DIVIDEND POLICY We have never declared or paid any cash dividends
on our common stock and do not anticipate paying any cash dividends in the foreseeable future. We anticipate that we will retain all of
our future earnings, if any, for use in the operation and expansion of our business and for general corporate purposes. Any future determination
to declare cash dividends will be made at the discretion of our board of directors, subject to applicable laws, and will depend on a number
of factors, including our financial condition, results of operations, capital requirements, contractual restrictions (including restrictions
under our current and future debt instruments), general business conditions, and other factors that our board of directors may deem relevant.
